The TL/TR are the first and last dates on which the full set was observed, not an outbreak window. This is the only sub-national evidence of any kind for Togo between 1974 and 2003. The TL/TR are the first and last dates on which the full set was observed, not an outbreak window. This is the only sub-national evidence of any kind for Togo between 1974 and 2003.
